prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in Sugar Land, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1429; do not mention it.)
text: On arrival at the scene, the reporting officer observed a rear-end collision involving two passenger vehicles in the eastbound lanes of a roadway in Sugar Land, Texas. Driver 1 was operating the lead vehicle, which was stopped in traffic at the time of impact. Driver 2 was operating the following vehicle and stated that the brakes did not engage in time to avoid contact. A passenger was present in the Driver 2 vehicle and was seated in the front passenger position. Both vehicles sustained rear and front-end damage respectively, and both were driven from the scene under their own power. Driver 1 stated that they were struck from behind and reported a headache and dizziness shortly after the collision. Driver 1 was evaluated on scene by responding medical personnel and reported symptoms consistent with a possible concussion. No citations were issued at the scene pending further review of the evidence. Weather was clear and the roadway was dry at the time of the incident.
